{{Article header|eyebrow=EDFM // Commander Reference|deck=Community tools, databases, applications and services commonly used alongside Elite Dangerous.}}

{{Needs review}}

Third-party tools and websites — not developed, hosted, or endorsed by Frontier Developments plc — that Elite Dangerous commanders commonly use alongside the game. Entries below are widely-recognised, long-established community staples, grouped by what they're for. This list is deliberately not exhaustive; see [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Contributing]] once public registration opens if you'd like to propose an addition.

== {{Section number|01}}Star systems, navigation and exploration ==
<div class="edfm-resource-grid">
{{Resource card
 |name=EDSM
 |fullname=Elite Dangerous Star Map
 |url=https://www.edsm.net/
 |description=Community-maintained database of star systems and bodies, built from commanders' journal uploads. Several other tools below build on its data.
 |tag1=Star map|tag2=System data|tag3=Exploration
}}
{{Resource card
 |name=Spansh
 |url=https://www.spansh.co.uk/
 |description=Route plotting: neutron-star-boosted exploration routes, "Road to Riches" high-value-body routing, and multi-hop trade routing.
 |tag1=Route planning|tag2=Neutron routing|tag3=Road to Riches|tag4=Trade
}}
</div>

== {{Section number|02}}Trading and general commander reference ==
<div class="edfm-resource-grid">
{{Resource card
 |name=Inara
 |url=https://inara.cz/
 |description=Community hub covering commander/squadron profiles, nearest-station and trade lookups, engineering material tracking, fleet carrier listings, and community goal tracking.
 |tag1=Commander|tag2=Squadron|tag3=Engineering|tag4=Markets|tag5=Fleet carriers
}}
</div>

== {{Section number|03}}Ship building ==
<div class="edfm-resource-grid">
{{Resource card
 |name=Coriolis
 |url=https://coriolis.io/
 |description=Ship loadout planner for comparing modules and engineering choices before committing credits or materials in-game. Builds can be shared as export codes.
 |tag1=Ship building|tag2=Engineering|tag3=Loadouts
}}
{{Resource card
 |name=EDSY
 |fullname=Elite Dangerous Shipyard
 |url=https://edsy.org/
 |description=Alternative loadout planner, covering the same core build-planning role as Coriolis with a different interface.
 |tag1=Ship building|tag2=Engineering|tag3=Thermals
}}
</div>

== {{Section number|04}}Companion apps (journal/API sync) ==
Several tools above draw their data from the game's own journal files and Frontier's companion API rather than manual entry. The most commonly installed app for this is:

<div class="edfm-resource-grid">
{{Resource card
 |name=EDMC
 |fullname=Elite Dangerous Market Connector
 |url=https://github.com/EDCD/EDMarketConnector
 |description=Background app, maintained by EDCD (Elite Dangerous Community Developers), that reads your journal and forwards data to services such as EDSM and Inara, and to EDDN, the shared open data feed several tools above are built on. Supports plugins.
 |tag1=Journal|tag2=API|tag3=Data sync|tag4=Plugins
}}
</div>

== {{Section number|05}}Voice and cockpit immersion ==
<div class="edfm-resource-grid">
{{Resource card
 |name=VoiceAttack
 |url=https://voiceattack.com/
 |description=General-purpose voice command software, not specific to Elite Dangerous, but very widely used in the community for hands-free ship control. Commander-made voice profiles for it are common.
 |tag1=Voice control|tag2=Cockpit
}}
</div>

== {{Section number|07}}Colonisation planning and construction ==
<div class="edfm-resource-grid">
{{Resource card
 |name=EDSC
 |fullname=Elite Dangerous System Constructor
 |url=https://www.edsc.info/
 |description=Tracks system claims and construction projects across colonisation sites, with a shopping-list feature to help locate needed commodities.
 |tag1=System claims|tag2=Construction tracking|tag3=Shopping list
}}
{{Resource card
 |name=Raven Colonial
 |url=https://ravencolonial.com/
 |description=Tracks build progress across single or multiple colonisation construction sites, aggregates cargo shopping lists, and includes a visual system-planning tool for previewing economies before construction begins.
 |tag1=Progress tracking|tag2=Multi-build|tag3=System planning
}}
{{Resource card
 |name=EDCH
 |fullname=ED Colonization Helper
 |url=https://edtrailblazer.com/
 |description=Tracks required and delivered materials for colonisation construction projects, with Fleet Carrier cargo support and saved progress across sessions.
 |tag1=Construction|tag2=Materials|tag3=Fleet carrier
}}
</div>

== {{Section number|08}}Engineering material tracking ==
<div class="edfm-resource-grid">
{{Resource card
 |name=EDEngineer
 |url=https://github.com/msarilar/EDEngineer
 |description=Real-time overlay that reads your journal to track materials, data, and cargo held toward Engineer blueprint requirements, with a shopping list and alerts when a favourited blueprint is ready to craft.
 |tag1=Engineering|tag2=Materials|tag3=Journal|tag4=Overlay
}}
</div>
